name: Walkthrough replay
responsibility: Mounts one viewer on a recorded talk and steps it frame by frame
description: The page a recording's picture is rendered in (drawn on Browser application and Board rasterizer). The walkthrough package publishes the page's side of the contract, so it reads the talk and its options, hands this page the parsed talk and answers how many frames the talk renders to. Loading a talk points the board reads at it, installs the stepped clock and mounts the viewer on the talk's board, its step driven by the talk. A talk recorded with --against has every picture it draws read against that variant.

outgoing.label: mount on the talk's board, its step driven
read boards from the talk
outgoing.description: The page or replay imports the semantic-board-canvas root. It re-exports readBoardsFrom from the implementing child, so the relationship ends on that public entry point.

outgoing.label: install the stepped clock; step it each frame
draw every picture against the talk's variant
